type.title: Site type
type.noVersion: No PHP version is installed. Install one under PHP first.
type.nowPHP: {{site}} is a PHP site with PHP {{version}} now.
type.nowStatic: {{site}} is a static site now. Its PHP pool is stopped.
type.toStatic: Files, databases, cron jobs, SSH logins and backups stay. Only the PHP pool is stopped; .php files are no longer run or sent. Your PHP settings are kept for a switch back.
type.toPHP: Files, databases, cron jobs, SSH logins and backups stay. The site gets its own PHP pool.
type.staffOnly: An administrator or manager can change the site to other types.

root.title: Web root
root.folderHint: The folder the site serves, below htdocs. Leave it empty for htdocs itself, or enter for example dist, public or build.
root.folderHintPHP: Laravel and similar frameworks serve public.
root.folderHintMissing: A folder that does not exist yet answers 404 until it is there.
root.spaHint: Addresses without a file get index.html instead of 404, for apps with their own routing (React, Vue, Svelte).
root.assetsHint: Browsers keep the listed file types for the chosen time without asking again. Turn it on only if file names or addresses change with their content, as with most build tools and WordPress; otherwise visitors see old files after a deploy.
root.cacheTimeHint: Between 1 minute and 365 days. Default: 30 days.
root.fileTypesHint: Separated by spaces or commas, without the dot. HTML stays fresh unless you add html.

problems.dirNames: Use folder names of letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', separated by '/', without a leading or trailing '/'.
problems.cacheTime: Choose a time between 1 minute and 365 days.
problems.noExt: Enter at least one file type.
problems.badExt: "{{ext}}" is not a file type. Use 1 to 10 letters or digits, without the dot.

settings.title: App settings
settings.savedRestarted: Saved. The app was restarted with it.

program.label: Program
program.hint: The executable file below the site's home, for example bin/server. Leave it empty until it is uploaded: the app starts once it is set and there.
program.argsHint: One per line, at most {{max}}. Each line reaches the program exactly as written, spaces and quotes included; no shell reads it.
program.workdirHint: The folder the program starts in, below the site's home.
program.note: The program gets PORT and HOST=127.0.0.1 and must listen there. It must belong to the site's user and be executable (chmod u+x). Upload it over SFTP or in Files, then start or restart the app.
program.savedWaiting: Saved. The app starts once its program is there.

env.title: Environment variables
env.none: None yet. The app gets PORT, HOST and the other basics from Hostashi.
env.stored: The values are stored encrypted and shown only while you edit them.
env.fieldHint: One per line as NAME=value, for example DATABASE_URL=mysql://… Names use A-Z, 0-9 and _. The value is taken as written, quotes included. Lines starting with # are left out. HOST, PORT, HOME, USER, LOGNAME and PATH are set by Hostashi.
env.savedRestarted: Saved. The app was restarted with them.
env.savedLater: Saved. The app gets them when it starts.

problems.badName: Line {{line}}: use A-Z, 0-9 and _ in the name, no digit first, at most 64 characters.
problems.valueLong: Line {{line}}: the value is longer than 4096 bytes.

node.workdirHint: The folder the app starts in, below the site's home. Usually where package.json is.

script.label: Start file
script.hint: Runs node with a .js, .mjs or .cjs file, for example server.js or dist/main.js.

npm.label: npm script
npm.hint: Runs npm run with a script from package.json, for example start.

none.label: Not yet
none.hint: The app stays stopped until a start command is set.

node.fileHint: Relative to the working directory. Runs: node {{start}}
node.note: The app gets PORT and HOST=127.0.0.1 and must listen there. NODE_ENV is production. Install the dependencies first, for example with npm ci over SSH.

python.workdirHint: The folder the app starts in, below the site's home. Usually where manage.py or main.py is.

wsgi.label: WSGI with gunicorn
wsgi.hint: Django, Flask and other WSGI apps. Install gunicorn in .venv.

asgi.label: ASGI with uvicorn
asgi.hint: FastAPI, Starlette, Django with ASGI. Install uvicorn in .venv.

script.label: Python file
script.hint: Runs a .py file that listens on HOST and PORT itself.

none.label: Not yet
none.hint: The app stays stopped until a start command is set.

python.extraArgsHint: One per line, at most {{max}}, for example --workers and 3 on two lines.
python.bindRefused: The address is Hostashi's: --bind, --host and --port are refused.
python.note: Hostashi creates the environment ~/.venv with this version. Install the packages into it over SSH, for example with ~/.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt. The app gets PORT and HOST=127.0.0.1.
python.noteWSGI: Hostashi creates the environment ~/.venv with this version. Install the packages into it over SSH, for example with ~/.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt and gunicorn. The app gets PORT and HOST=127.0.0.1.
python.noteASGI: Hostashi creates the environment ~/.venv with this version. Install the packages into it over SSH, for example with ~/.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt and uvicorn. The app gets PORT and HOST=127.0.0.1.
python.rebuiltBody: Every package installed in it goes, gunicorn and uvicorn too. Install them again over SSH afterwards; until then the app stays stopped. Your files in the home stay.
python.savedPackages: Saved. The app starts once its packages are installed in .venv.
python.venvIntro: The app runs from <mono>~/.venv</mono> with Python {{version}}. Over SSH, <mono>python</mono> and <mono>pip</mono> in <mono>~/.venv/bin</mono> install into it.
python.recreateWhy: This helps when .venv is broken or was deleted.
python.recreated: The environment was created again. Install the packages over SSH, then start the app.

app.title: App
app.setStart: Set a start command below, then the app starts.
app.setProgram: Set the program below, then the app starts.
app.appWaiting: The app is not started yet.
app.programWaiting: The program is not started yet.
app.siteDisabled: The site is disabled, so its app is stopped. It starts again when the site is enabled.
app.broken: The app is not running as it should.
app.stoppedNote: A stopped app stays stopped, also after a reboot, until it is started again. After a crash it restarts by itself.

problems.workdirEmpty: Enter the working directory, for example htdocs.
problems.workdirLong: The folder name is too long.
problems.workdirInvalid: Use a folder below the home: letters, digits, . _ - and /, no .. and no leading /.
problems.npmScript: Enter the name of an npm script, for example start: lowercase letters, digits and : _ -.
problems.nodeExt: The start file must end in .js, .mjs or .cjs.
problems.fileInvalid: Use a file below the working directory: letters, digits, . _ - and /, no .. and no leading /.
problems.programDepth: Use a file at most 4 folders below the home.
problems.programInvalid: Use a file below the home, for example bin/server: letters, digits, . _ - and /, no .. and no leading /.
problems.nodeMissing: No Node.js version is installed. An administrator installs one under Runtimes › Node.js.
problems.pythonExt: The start file must end in .py.
problems.pythonTarget: Enter module.path:callable, for example mysite.wsgi:application or main:app.
problems.bindSet: {{option}} is set by Hostashi: the app listens on 127.0.0.1 and its own port.
problems.pythonMissing: No Python version is installed. An administrator installs one under Runtimes › Python.

errors.appsStillRun: Sites still run on this version. Move them to another version first.
errors.installRunning: Another installation is still running. Wait until it is done.
errors.venvFailed: The environment .venv could not be created: {{reason}}

php.title: PHP settings
php.intro: Leave a field empty for the Hostashi default. These are defaults for the site: its own .user.ini or ini_set() can still change them. The server's limits still apply: nginx takes no request larger than the largest request and waits no longer than the execution time, and the site's memory limit stays the ceiling.
php.errorReportingHint: error_reporting. Production reports all but deprecations, development everything.
php.displayErrorsHint: display_errors. Keep it off on a live site.
php.outOfRange: Some values are out of range. Check the marked fields.
php.saved: Saved. PHP and nginx use the new values now.
php.resetDone: All PHP settings are back to the defaults.
php.numberProblem: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}, or leave it empty for the default.
php.memoryWarning: {{workers}} PHP workers with {{each}} MiB each could use {{total}} MiB, more than the site's memory limit of {{limit}} MiB. If they all need that much at once, the kernel stops one of them. Lower the memory limit or the workers, or raise the site's limit.

errors.notFound: The site does not exist anymore.
errors.failed: The PHP settings could not be loaded or saved. Try again.

pageCache.title: Page cache
pageCache.intro: nginx keeps the pages that PHP generates for a few minutes and serves them to the next visitors without starting PHP. Changes show up after the cache time at the latest, or right after you empty the cache.
pageCache.warnTitle: Check that no page shows personal data without a login
pageCache.warnBody: The cache cannot tell what a page contains. If your application shows personal data without a cookie or a “Cache-Control: private” header, for example through a token in the address, another visitor could get that page. Exclude such paths below.

wordpress.label: WordPress
wordpress.hint: Skips logged-in users, password-protected posts, comment authors, the admin area, the login, cron, XML-RPC, the REST API and previews.

woocommerce.label: WooCommerce
woocommerce.hint: Like WordPress, and skips carts, the checkout, the account pages and add-to-cart requests.

php.label: Other PHP application
php.hint: Skips every request with a cookie, because a cookie may mean a session. Safe for any application, but fewer pages come from the cache.

pageCache.cacheTimeHint: How long a page is kept. Pages with errors other than 404 are never kept.
pageCache.excludedHint: One per line. /path is only that page, /path* every address that starts with it, for example /cart*.
pageCache.sizeHint: Cached pages count against the site's disk space.
pageCache.sizeInfo: Size: at most {{size}}, counted against the site's disk space. Managers and administrators can change it.
pageCache.stopped: Not used while the site is disabled or in maintenance. It starts empty afterwards.
pageCache.emptied: The page cache is empty. The next visits fill it again.
pageCache.headerHint: The answer header <mono>X-Cache</mono> shows HIT, MISS or BYPASS. A CMS can empty the cache on save with an API token that has only the scope <mono>pagecache:purge</mono> for this site: <mono>POST /api/v1/sites/{{site}}/page-cache/purge</mono>.

problems.badPath: “{{path}}” is not a path. Start with /, use letters, digits and . _ ~ % / - only, and put * only at the end.

errors.rate_limited: The cache was emptied a moment ago. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.forbidden: Only managers and administrators can change the size.
errors.site_busy: The site is being created or deleted. Try again in a moment.
errors.refused: The web server did not accept the change. The previous settings stay active.
errors.failed: The request failed. Check the connection and try again.

objectCache.title: Object cache
objectCache.switch: Run an object cache (Valkey, compatible with Redis) for this site
objectCache.switchHint: Only this site's PHP, cron jobs and SSH logins reach it, over a socket. It keeps nothing on disk: a restart, a flush or a new size empties it. Its memory counts against the site's memory limit.
objectCache.enableSiteFirst: Enable the site first to turn the cache on.
objectCache.paused: The site is disabled, so its cache is stopped. It starts again with the site.
objectCache.sizeInfo: Size: {{n}} MiB. An administrator or manager can change it.
objectCache.socketHint: Apps connect here instead of 127.0.0.1:6379. No password.
objectCache.wpHint: With the Redis Object Cache plugin. Hostashi does not install plugins.
objectCache.on: The object cache runs now. Point the site's app at the socket below.
objectCache.flushed: The object cache is empty now.
objectCache.resized: The cache has {{n}} MiB now. Resizing emptied it.
objectCache.sizeLater: The cache gets {{n}} MiB when it is turned on.

errors.object_cache_unavailable: The object cache is not available on this server.
errors.site_busy: The site is being created, deleted or is disabled. Try again later.
errors.forbidden: Only administrators and managers can change the size.
errors.notStarted: The cache did not start. The previous setting stays.
errors.failed: The request failed. Check the connection and try again.

snippets.title: Custom nginx snippets
snippets.intro: For rules Hostashi has no setting for yet: headers, redirects, extra locations. Only allowed directives pass; paths must stay inside the site's home. Snippets are not used while the site is disabled or in maintenance.
snippets.rootHint: Before Hostashi's try_files, for every request that no other location takes.
snippets.none: The site has no custom snippets now.
snippets.tooBig: A snippet can be at most 64 KiB.

errors.snippet_rejected: Some lines are not allowed. Nothing was saved.
errors.site_missing: Create the site on this server first.
errors.site_busy: The site is being created or deleted. Try again in a moment.
errors.refused: The web server did not accept the change. The previous snippets stay active.
errors.failed: The request failed. Check the connection and try again.
